source: ChatGPT Slugshot Content & Culture Intelligence, Codebook v1.0 (24 Nov 2026). Pilot before freezing; bump the version on every change and recode the pilot.
unit_of_analysis: one accessible post or clip; record timestamp window, language evidence and playback access

states.present: the criterion is observable in the item
states.absent: enough of the item was accessible to say it is not there
states.uncertain: ambiguous; review separately, do not force

rules: Hide metrics, ranks, sample role and performance labels before coding (`ss analyze blind-packet`); if outcomes were seen, mark the annotation unblinded.
'absent' needs full_playback or excerpt access covering the relevant moment.
Record opening, complication, attempt, reversal and payoff beats, timing, visual proof and voice/dialect as observed.
Keep meme_id, sound_id, format_id, genre_id and concept_id distinct.
Examples are invented anchors, not evidence.

codes.criterion: opening shows or voices opposing goals
explicit fictional or general rule sets stakes
explicit alternatives with a viewer decision
a response is the central payoff
sound timed to an observable beat
